immediate_live.note: immediate dispatch; no local queue or pacing budget

paced_fifo_live.note: whole access-unit dispatch attempts incur framed-bit debt regardless of downstream admission; expiry and dependency suppression affect only unsent units; all age is measured from original capture time; idle credit is not accumulated; expiry wins readiness ties within 1e-9 ms at its actual timestamp, never early

bounded_paced_live.note: whole access-unit dispatch attempts incur framed-bit debt regardless of downstream admission; expiry and dependency suppression affect only unsent units; all age is measured from original capture time; idle credit is not accumulated; expiry wins readiness ties within 1e-9 ms at its actual timestamp, never early

immediate_replay_bounded_source.note: immediate dispatch; no local queue or pacing budget

offline_control.note: offline immediate dispatch of ALL generated bounded-run units, including those locally discarded; isolates sender handling conditioned on that realized source

quality_comparison.note: matched RGB PSNR uses source IDs decoded by all four arms; lost/late presentation is measured separately

scope.clock: real local H.264; virtual capture, dispatch, media, feedback and playout clocks
scope.causality: sender queue uses generated units, elapsed time and applied target only; no future capacity, admission, loss or in-flight occupancy input
scope.pacing: one immediate whole access unit then framed-bit debt; every attempt is charged even on link rejection; no packet fragmentation or per-instant rate guarantee
scope.queue: only unsent local units can expire; descendants suppressed until a verified IDR; at most eight configured local repair requests, coalesced with rate/remote recovery
scope.events: queued events through capture precede receiver decisions; expiry wins dispatch tie; repair/feedback at exact capture cannot alter that frame; new units may dispatch at capture
scope.age: original capture time survives local waiting; full capture horizon used for all playout slots
scope.tail: watchdog stops at source end; queued units drain/expire at the frozen target; tail arrivals observed but no further encoder action applies
scope.attribution: FIFO versus bounded includes eviction, dependency suppression and local repair; exact-source replay isolates their combined sender handling with pacing
scope.paired_link: same parameters/seed; changed admission can shift jitter/loss draws; zero jitter and zero random loss remove this pairing ambiguity
scope.limits: bounded synthetic source, conservative closed-GOP dependencies, ideal reliable reverse feedback; no physical network/display, Colab allocation or capacity guarantee
